paragraphs.text: Fractal is a creature subtype for creatures magically composed of fractals . Fractal creature type primarily appears in Strixhaven-related sets and serves as the mascot for Quandrix .
Fractals have only appeared in blue and green .

The Fractal creature type was introduced in Strixhaven: School of Mages . More Fractals were printed with the subtype in Secrets of Strixhaven , expanding its design beyond the "0/0 with counters" that most are.
“Fractals are just pseudo-dimensional manifestations of asynchronous biosymmetries. It’s really quite simple.”

Fractal creatures are created as mascots by the Quandrix College students of Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios . Because they are essentially formulaic representations of creatures brought to life, they can be mathematically scaled in size from tiny to enormous, making them effective companions for mages who use them as playthings, pets, helpers, and allies in combat.

Fractal creature tokens always have a base power and toughness of 0/0 and can come with any number of +1/+1 counters . Fractal creators are often unique (18 different conditions in 28 fractal makers) in their way of determining their token's size, and reflecting the flavor are often different sizes in different contexts.
